roots.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 stallum（座位、摊位、畜栏里隔出的一格）借自法兰克语／古高地德语 *stal（位置、棚位），英语 stall 同出这一支；古法语 installer 与盎格鲁-法语 estaler 皆由此。与库中 sta 一族不同源，那一族讲的是站立
roots.core_concept: a place marked off and assigned to one thing / 划出来专归某一样占的那个位子
roots.core_image: 马棚里一格一格隔开，每匹马认自己那一格，进去就站定不再挪
roots.english_definition: to set into an assigned place; a stall, a fixed seat

concepts.concept: a place marked off and assigned to one thing
concepts.core_image: 马棚里一格一格隔开，每匹马认自己那一格，进去就站定不再挪

words.origin: 古法语 ypocrisie ← 晚期拉丁语 hypocrisis ← 希腊语 hupokrisis，由 hupo（在下）与 krinesthai（在面具后应答、扮演）合成；承义的是扮演这一支，不是库中 crit 那个判别一义
words.native_definition: the pretence of having moral standards that one's own behaviour does not meet
words.core_concept: saying one thing while doing another – 嘴上一套，做的是另一套
words.core_image: 台上讲着戒烟的道理，散场后他躲到楼梯间点了一支
examples: He was accused of hypocrisy over the tax issue.
Their silence now smells of pure hypocrisy.
semantic_expansions: 伪善：好听的道德话说在前头，自己并不照做
虚伪：整个人的姿态都是装的，不止一句话
言行不一：说的与做的对不上，这是它最实在的样子
words.decomposable_note: 希腊借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 晚期拉丁语 incentivum（起头的那个调子）← incinere（吹响、起个调），由 in-（进入）与 canere（歌唱、吹奏）合成；库中未为 canere 一支建根
words.native_definition: something that encourages a person to work harder or act in a certain way
words.core_concept: what sets someone moving – 让人动起来的那个由头
words.core_image: 老板宣布这个月多卖十台就加一份钱，几个人立刻直起腰
examples: Tax breaks give firms an incentive to hire.
She had little incentive to finish the work.
semantic_expansions: 激励：外面给出的那个由头，推着人往前
动机：这个由头落到心里，成了他做事的原因
刺激：用在市场和行业上，指拨一下让它活动起来
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 拉丁语 inferior（更低的）← inferus（下面的）加比较级 -ior；与库中 ferre 一族无关，-fer- 在此不是承义成分，也不含 -terior 那套对照级构词
words.native_definition: lower in rank, quality or importance than something else
words.core_concept: standing lower when the two are compared – 两个一比，位置在下的那个
words.core_image: 两块布并排一比，右边那块摸着薄，纹路也糙，价钱只有一半
examples: This copy is inferior to the original.
He never treated his staff as inferiors.
semantic_expansions: 较差的：质量上比出来低的那一个
下级的：位次上比出来低的那一层
下属：作名词，指位次在下的那个人
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.root_logic: inter-（两者之间）+ course（currere 跑）→ 话与事在双方之间来回跑动
words.origin: 古法语 entrecours ← 晚期拉丁语 intercursus（在两者之间跑动）← intercurrere，由 inter-（之间）与 currere（跑）合成
words.native_definition: communication or dealings between people, or physical sexual contact
words.core_concept: running to and fro between two sides – 在双方之间来回跑动
words.core_image: 两个村子之间那条路上，挑担的、送信的整天两头对着走
examples: Trade intercourse between the two ports grew.
The book avoids all mention of intercourse.
semantic_expansions: 交往：人与人之间来回走动、来回说话
往来：书面些的说法，多指国与国、地与地之间
性交：两个身体之间最贴近的那种来回，英语里的专称

words.origin: 拉丁语 interim（在这中间、暂且），由 inter（在…之间）加副词尾 -im 构成；inter- 只是前缀、不承载词义，故本词不归入任何词根
words.native_definition: intended to last only until something permanent is arranged
words.core_concept: filling the gap between two settled states – 两个定局之间那段空当
words.core_image: 老校长走了，新的还没定，先由教务主任坐那把椅子三个月
examples: An interim manager will run the office.
In the interim, keep the old rules.
semantic_expansions: 临时的：只管这段空当，到期就换掉
过渡的：这段空当是从旧的走到新的那一程
间歇：作名词，指中间空出来的那一段时间
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 古法语 enterpreter ← 拉丁语 interpretari（居间说合）← 拉丁语 interpres（站在两方中间的人），其后半来历无定论，与库中 pretium 一族不合并
words.native_definition: to explain the meaning of something, or to translate what someone says
words.core_concept: standing between and making the sense pass – 站在中间把意思递过去
words.core_image: 两人各说各的话，中间那个先听一句，转过头用另一种话说一遍
examples: Lawyers interpret this old rule in two ways.
She interpreted for the visiting delegation.
semantic_expansions: 解释：把不明白的说法讲成明白的
理解：同一句话，各人把它接成不同的意思
口译：站在两种语言之间当场转述
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.root_logic: inter-（彼此之间）+ view（videre 看）→ 两人隔桌相对而看，一问一答
words.origin: 中古法语 entrevue ← s'entrevoir（彼此相看），由 entre-（之间）与 voir（看）合成，voir 出自拉丁语 videre
words.native_definition: a formal meeting where someone is asked questions, or to hold such a meeting
words.core_concept: two sitting face to face for questions – 两人相对而坐，一问一答
words.core_image: 一张桌子两把椅子，对面的人一边问一边在纸上记，他坐直了答
examples: She has an interview on Monday morning.
The reporter interviewed three of the workers.
semantic_expansions: 面试：为定用不用你而设的那一场对坐
采访：记者对坐着问，为的是把话写出去
面谈：不为选拔也不为发表，就是坐下来谈一次

words.origin: 拉丁语 intricatus ← intricare（缠住、绕乱），由 in-（进入）与 tricae（缠人的琐事、乱麻）合成；库中未为 tricae 一支建根
words.native_definition: having many small parts or details arranged in a complicated way
words.core_concept: so tangled that the parts are hard to follow – 绕得太密，一根根跟不下来
words.core_image: 一小块木雕上镂着十几层花纹，绕来绕去分不清哪根接哪根
examples: The lock has an intricate inner mechanism.
She wove an intricate pattern of leaves.
semantic_expansions: 复杂的：部件多、绕得密，看不到头
错综的：几路线索互相穿插，分不出主次
精细的：这种绕法是手艺，密而不乱
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 法语 intrigue ← 意大利语 intrigo ← intrigare ← 拉丁语 intricare（缠住、绕乱）；与 intricate 同出一源，库中未为这一支建根
words.native_definition: a secret plan to do something bad, or to make someone very interested
words.core_concept: a tangle woven out of sight – 背地里绕出来的一团
words.core_image: 三个人在走廊尽头低声排一件事，见人过来就散开，各自笑一下
examples: The court was full of plots and intrigue.
His silence intrigued everyone at the table.
semantic_expansions: 阴谋：暗地里绕出来的那一套安排
密谋：作动词，几个人凑在一处绕这套安排
引起兴趣：绕得不明不白，反倒把人的心勾住
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 古法语 intrinseque ← 晚期拉丁语 intrinsecus（在里面的），由 intra（在内）与 secus（沿着、随着）合成；承义的是 intra 这一半，库中 secare 与跟随那一族都不收它
words.native_definition: belonging to the basic nature of something rather than added from outside
words.core_concept: sitting inside from the start, not added on – 一开始就在里头，不是外加的
words.core_image: 玉不上漆也温润，把它扔进河里捞出来，那份质地还在
examples: Danger is intrinsic to this kind of work.
The stone has intrinsic value, not just style.
semantic_expansions: 固有的：本来就带着，不是后来添的
内在的：位置在里头，从外面看不见
本质的：去掉外面那些，剩下的还是它
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 法语 hélicoptère（1861 年造词），由希腊语 helix（螺旋）与 pteron（翅膀）合成；库中未为这两支建根
words.native_definition: an aircraft lifted by long blades that spin above it
words.core_concept: lifted by a spinning wing overhead – 靠头顶那片旋转的翼抬起来
words.core_image: 头顶几片长叶子转成一个圆盘，机身原地离地，草被压得往四面倒
examples: A helicopter landed on the hospital roof.
They reached the island by helicopter.
words.decomposable_note: 经法语入英语的借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.root_logic: hero（受传颂的勇士）+ -in（药物名后缀）→ 药厂取名时说用了它的人自觉了得
words.origin: 德语 Heroin（1898 年拜耳公司的商品名）← 希腊语 hērōs（勇士）加药物后缀 -in；与 heroine 只差一个字母，来历同源而所指天差地别
words.native_definition: a strongly addictive drug made from morphine
words.core_concept: the drug named for the swagger it gives – 因用后那股了得劲而得名的药
words.core_image: 一小包白粉在灯下称重，用过的人说那一刻自己无所不能，随后停不下
examples: Police seized two kilos of heroin.
He spent five years addicted to heroin.

words.origin: 拉丁语 illuminatus ← illuminare（照亮），由 in-（进入）与 lumen（光）合成；库中未为 lumen 一支建根
words.native_definition: to light something up, or to make a subject easier to understand
words.core_concept: letting light in so a thing can be seen – 让光进去，东西才看得见
words.core_image: 一盏灯打在墙上的图上，原先看不清的线条一下全显出来
examples: Floodlights illuminate the whole front wall.
Her notes illuminate a difficult passage.
semantic_expansions: 照亮：光打进去，形状显出来
阐明：道理也这样被照出来，原先含混的变清楚
启发：光落到人身上，他自己就看明白了
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.root_logic: imit（imitari 照着摹样做，与 imago 摹本同支）+ -ate → 拿本物当样子，照它做出一个
words.origin: 拉丁语 imitor / imitari（照样做、摹仿），与 imago（摹本、相像之物）同出一支
words.native_definition: to copy the way someone speaks or behaves, or to make a likeness of something
words.core_concept: making one that follows the model – 照着样子做出一个
words.core_image: 他把老师走路时那个小停顿学下来，同学一看就知道说的是谁
examples: Children imitate the adults around them.
This plastic imitates real leather closely.
semantic_expansions: 模仿：把别人的样子学过来，声音、动作都算
仿造：照原物做一个假的，为的是像
效法：把别人的做法当样子学，不带贬义

words.root_logic: imitat（imitari 照样做，与 imago 摹本同支）+ -ion → 照样做这件事，或照样做出来的那个东西
words.origin: 古法语 imitacion ← 拉丁语 imitatio ← imitari（照样做）；与 imitate 是同一个词，只是 Wiktionary 分录了 imitor 与 imitacion 两个词形
words.native_definition: the act of copying something, or a copy made to resemble the real thing
words.core_concept: a copy set beside the model – 照样子做出来放在旁边的那个
words.core_image: 柜台上摆着两只表，左边贵得多，右边看着一样但拿起来轻
examples: Her imitation of the teacher made us laugh.
This bag is a cheap imitation.
semantic_expansions: 模仿：照样做这件事本身
仿制品：照样做出来的那个东西，与真品对着摆
仿造的：作定语，说明它是照真的做的，不是真的

words.origin: 拉丁语 immigrans（迁进来的，现在分词），由 in-（进入）与 migrare（迁移）合成；库中未为 migrare 一支建根，emigrate 也还是孤立词条
words.native_definition: a person who comes to live permanently in another country
words.core_concept: one who has moved in to stay – 迁进来长住的那个人
words.core_image: 他拎着两只箱子走出机场，手里那张纸上盖着新国家的章
examples: Many immigrants settled near the harbour.
The city has a large immigrant population.
semantic_expansions: 移民：从别国迁进来长住的那个人
外来移民的：作定语，说明人或社群是这样迁进来的
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 拉丁语 inevitabilis（躲不开的），由 in-（不）与 evitare（避开）合成，evitare 出自 vitare（回避）；vitare 与 vita（生命）不同源，库中未为它建根
words.native_definition: certain to happen and impossible to prevent
words.core_concept: no way left to step aside from it – 已经没有侧身让开的余地
words.core_image: 河水已经漫过第一级台阶，谁都看得出下一级也守不住
examples: A second delay now looks inevitable.
War seemed inevitable by that summer.
semantic_expansions: 不可避免的：想躲也没有路可躲
必然的：不只躲不开，还一定会来
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 拉丁语 inflatio（吹胀）← inflare，由 in-（进入）与 flare（吹）合成；库中未为 flare 一支建根
words.native_definition: a general rise in prices, or the act of filling something with air
words.core_concept: blown up bigger without more substance – 吹得更大，里头并没多出东西
words.core_image: 去年五块的一碗面今年要七块，钱包厚度没变，能买的东西少了
examples: Inflation rose to six percent last year.
The inflation of the balloon took minutes.
semantic_expansions: 通货膨胀：钱这一头被吹大了，东西还是那么多
膨胀：泛指被吹得变大，数字与说法都能这样
充气：本义，把气打进去让它鼓起来
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.root_logic: in-（进入）+ stall（stallum 位子）→ 把东西送进它该占的那个位子，固定住
words.origin: 古法语 installer ← 中世纪拉丁语 installare，由 in-（进入）与 stallum（座位、摊位）合成
words.native_definition: to fix equipment in place so it can be used, or to put someone formally into a post
words.core_concept: setting a thing into the place kept for it – 把东西送进留给它的那个位子
words.core_image: 师傅把新机器抬进预留的方框，四角对上螺孔，逐个拧紧
examples: They installed a new boiler last week.
She was installed as chair in May.
semantic_expansions: 安装：机器、软件被放进该在的位置并固定
任命：人也这样被放进一个位子，多带仪式
使就位：泛指把某物某人安顿到位

words.root_logic: install（送进位子）+ -ation → 送进位子这件事，以及事后立在那儿的那一套
words.origin: 古法语 installation ← 中世纪拉丁语 installatio ← installare（送进位子）
words.native_definition: the act of putting equipment in place, the equipment itself, or a work of art set up in a space
words.core_concept: the setting in place, and what stands there after – 送进位子这件事，以及事后立着的东西
words.core_image: 车间里一整套管子和阀门已经架好，墙上贴着当天验收的单子
examples: The installation of the system took days.
A large installation filled the gallery floor.
semantic_expansions: 安装：把设备送进位子这个过程
装置：送进位子后立在那儿的那一整套东西
就职：人被送进位子的那一场仪式
装置艺术：在展厅里搭起来的一整件作品，同一个道理

words.root_logic: in-（进入）+ stall（stallum 位子）+ -ment → 一次只把一份安到位，安满为止
words.origin: 盎格鲁-法语 estalement（分期安排）← estaler（安放到位）← estal（位子），与 install 同出中世纪拉丁语 stallum 那一支
words.native_definition: one of several parts in which something is paid or published over time
words.core_concept: one portion set in place at a time – 一次只安上去一份
words.core_image: 买冰箱不用一次付清，每月十号从卡里划走一份，划满十二次
examples: He pays for the car in monthly installments.
The next installment appears on Friday.
semantic_expansions: 分期付款：钱一份份安到位，直到付满
一期：整件事被切成几份，这是其中一份
连载的一集：故事也这样一份份放出来，一次一集

words.root_logic: hand（手）+ ker（cooperire 盖住）+ chief（caput 头）→ 本是盖头的那块布，后来改拿在手上
words.origin: 由 hand 与 kerchief 复合；kerchief ← 古法语 cuevrechief，由 couvrir（盖）与 chief（头）合成，本指盖头的布
words.native_definition: a small square of cloth used for wiping the nose or face
words.core_concept: the head cloth now carried in the hand – 原本盖头、如今拿在手里的那块布
words.core_image: 一块巴掌大的方布，叠成四折塞在裤兜，掏出来擦一下额头
examples: He wiped his brow with a handkerchief.
She kept a clean handkerchief in her sleeve.
semantic_expansions: 手帕：随身带着擦脸擦手的那块方布
手绢：同一样东西，口语里的叫法

words.origin: 由古英语 hand（手）与 writing 复合；write 出自古英语 wrītan（刻、划）← 原始日耳曼语 *wrītan
words.native_definition: writing done with a pen or pencil, or a person's particular style of it
words.core_concept: marks left by the moving hand – 手动起来留下的那些痕
words.core_image: 同一句话两个人抄下来，一个笔画立着，一个连成一片斜的
examples: I cannot read his handwriting at all.
The note was in her own handwriting.
semantic_expansions: 字迹：某个人写出来的那副模样
笔迹：同一样东西，用在辨认是谁写的时候
书写：用手写字这个行为本身，与打印相对
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.root_logic: head（居首）+ master（magister，出自 magis 更大的那一支）→ 一群教书人里位次更高的那一位
words.origin: 由 head（古英语 hēafod，头）与 master 复合；master ← 古英语 mægester ← 拉丁语 magister（师傅、掌事者），由 magis（更多、更大）派生
words.native_definition: a man who is the head teacher of a school
words.core_concept: the greater one among the teachers – 教书人里居上的那一位
words.core_image: 全校集会时站在台阶最上那级说话的那个人，别的老师站在他两侧
examples: The headmaster called his parents that evening.
She replaced the retiring headmaster in September.
semantic_expansions: 校长：一所学校里位次最高的那位
男校长：英式用法里专指男性，女性作 headmistress

words.root_logic: head（居首）+ quarters（quartus 划出的那一块地方，引申为驻地）→ 众驻地里居首的那一处
words.origin: 由 head 与 quarters 复合；quarters（驻地）出自 quarter，本指均分成四份里的一份，引申为划给人住的那一块
words.native_definition: the main office from which an organization is controlled
words.core_concept: the chief one among the quarters – 众驻地里居首的那一处
words.core_image: 一栋挂着总旗的楼，各地的电话都往这里打，命令从这里发出去
examples: The company moved its headquarters to Leeds.
Orders came straight from headquarters that night.
semantic_expansions: 总部：一家机构的事都由这一处定
司令部：军队里的那一处，发号令的地方

words.origin: 中古英语 huswif，由古英语 hūs（房屋）与 wīf（女子、妻子）复合
words.native_definition: a married woman who works at home for her family instead of at a job
words.core_concept: the woman whose work is the house – 活儿全在这所房子里的那个女人
words.core_image: 上午买菜下午晾衣，锅里炖着晚饭，她一整天没出过这个门
examples: She was a housewife for twenty years.
Many housewives went back to work then.
semantic_expansions: 家庭妇女：不外出上班、在家操持的已婚女子
主妇：同一角色，中性些的说法，也指一家的女主人
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 由古英语 hūs（房屋）与 weorc（活计）复合
words.native_definition: the cleaning, cooking and washing that has to be done in a home
words.core_concept: the work the house keeps asking for – 这所房子不断要人做的那些活
words.core_image: 地要拖，碗要洗，衣服堆在盆里，做完一样又冒出下一样
examples: They share the housework every week.
Housework takes her three hours a day.
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 中古英语 in side，由古英语 in（在内）与 sīde（边、面）复合
words.native_definition: in or into the inner part of something
words.core_concept: on the inner side of a boundary – 界线里头那一边
words.core_image: 箱盖一掀，四壁围住的那一小块空处塞着几封旧信
examples: The keys are inside the brown bag.
He painted the inside of the door.
semantic_expansions: 在…里面：作介词，指位置落在界线以内
内部：作名词，指围住的那一块本身
内侧的：作定语，说明是靠里那一面的
collocations: inside sth —— 在某物之内，也表在某段时间之内，如 inside a week
inside out —— 里朝外，又引申为彻底地，know sth inside out
the inside of sth —— 某物的内部，作名词用时要带 the
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.root_logic: in-（使）+ sur（securus 不必再挂心）+ -ance → 先出一笔钱把后顾之忧买掉，落成一纸约据
words.origin: 由 insure 加 -ance 构成；insure 与 ensure 同出古法语 enseurer ← seur（无忧的）← 拉丁语 securus，由 se-（脱离）与 cura（挂心）合成
words.native_definition: an arrangement in which you pay a company and it pays your costs if something goes wrong
words.core_concept: paid so the worry need not be carried – 花钱把担心交出去
words.core_image: 每年交一笔钱换一纸约据，车真撞坏了修钱由公司出
examples: Her car insurance costs more this year.
Keep the receipt as insurance against loss.
semantic_expansions: 保险：出钱买下的那份约据，出事由对方赔
保险费：为这份约据每期交的那笔钱
保障：泛指用来防万一的那层东西，不限于钱

words.origin: 古英语 intō，由 in（在内）与 tō（向）合成，本是连写的两个词
words.native_definition: to a position inside or in contact with something
words.core_concept: moving from outside to a place within – 从外头进到里头
words.core_image: 硬币从指间落下，穿过瓶口，掉在瓶底叮的一声
examples: She poured the milk into a glass.
The rain turned into snow by evening.
semantic_expansions: 进入：从外面移到里面这个动作
到…里：作介词点出终点在某物内部
变成：一样东西转过去成了另一样，也用它
collocations: be into sth —— 对某事很感兴趣，口语常用
turn / change into sth —— 变成某物，强调变化后的结果
look into sth —— 调查某事，目光进到里头去
divide sth into … —— 把某物分成几份，后面接份数
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆
